title: Affine smooth model in a noetherian approximation
statement: For the data of the eventual smoothness theorem, there are a later stage j, a scheme Z and a finitely presented quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism q : Z → D(j.left), with q smooth, together with an isomorphism from Z to the pullback of p.

source.place: Tag 0C0C, limits.tex, lemma-descend-smooth, with Situation 081D; affine descent via Tag 0CAQ and comparison via Tag 01ZM(2)-(3)

proof.text: Apply affine smooth algebra descent through filtered colimits to finitely many affine charts. Descend the comparison isomorphism, its inverse, and the two inverse identities by the finite-presentation comparison theorem. Take a common later stage.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0C0C, expanding the affine-local reduction using Tags 0CAQ and 01ZM(2)-(3)

lean.statement:
theorem Scheme.NoetherianApproximation.exists_smooth_affine_model
    {S : Scheme.{u}} (N : S.NoetherianApproximation) {i : N.I}
    {Y X : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ N.D.obj i)
    [LocallyOfFinitePresentation p] [QuasiCompact p] [QuasiSeparated p]
    (f : X ⟶ S) [Smooth f] (a : X ⟶ Y)
    (H : IsPullback a f p (N.π.app i)) :
    ∃ (j : Over i) (Z : Scheme.{u}) (q : Z ⟶ N.D.obj j.left)
      (_ : LocallyOfFinitePresentation q) (_ : QuasiCompact q) (_ : QuasiSeparated q),
      Smooth q ∧ Nonempty (Z ≅ Limits.pullback p (N.D.map j.hom))
